title: Saturday Night Plans
introduction: A relaxed romance-drama scenario about the Harper sisters and their friends getting ready for a Saturday night party: one settled couple, one maybe-couple, and an evening that is still wide open.

scenario.summary: Helga Harper and Espen Harper are sisters who share a small apartment in Night City. Helga is together with Jack Carter; their relationship is affectionate, playful, and stable. Espen and Ryan Parker have been getting closer for weeks. They are not together, but they clearly like each other, and everyone keeps it light and unspoken. Tonight the whole group is going to a party. Nothing is planned or forced: it is just friends coming from work, getting ready, and heading out for a fun night. Whatever happens between Espen and Ryan is left completely open.
scenario.openingSituation: It's Saturday the 19th at 3:00 p.m. Everyone is getting ready for tonight's party. Espen is at the store buying drinks and snacks for the evening. Helga is at home in the apartment, doing her makeup and texting Jack. Jack and Ryan are also preparing at their respective homes. The evening hasn't started yet; how they all come together and how the night unfolds remains completely open.
scenario.currentSituation: It's Saturday the 19th at 3:00 p.m., and the party is still ahead of them. Helga and Jack are an established couple. Between Espen and Ryan there is mutual interest without a fixed definition. The night could go in any direction.
